moments.title: The games were fun and she learned while playing them
moments.summary: A student, prompted by the facilitator, says the games were fun and that she learned through playing them.
moments.evidence: The games were fun and I learned to learn playing them.

moments.title: A student names diversification and explains it in her own words
moments.summary: Pushed by the facilitator to be specific, she names diversification, then explains it as not putting all your money in one place because you can't use everything.
moments.evidence: I learned that we should not like put all our money in pocket.
